# SmartSleep

[![Paper 1.21+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Paper-1.21%2B-8b5cf6?style=for-the-badge)](https://papermc.io/)
[![Java 21](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-f97316?style=for-the-badge)](https://adoptium.net/)
[![Maven](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20with-Maven-0ea5e9?style=for-the-badge)](https://maven.apache.org/)
[![MiniMessage](https://img.shields.io/badge/Text-MiniMessage-22c55e?style=for-the-badge)](https://docs.advntr.dev/minimessage/format.html)

Premium sleep and weather voting for modern survival servers.

SmartSleep turns bed entry into a polished server-wide voting flow. Players vote directly in a clean GUI, bosses/actionbar keep the vote visible in real time, and the night or rain is skipped only when your configured threshold is reached.

## What It Does

- Opens a vote when a player enters a bed
- Lets eligible players vote `YES` or `NO`
- Supports separate night and rain voting
- Updates vote progress in real time
- Skips the night or clears weather when the threshold is met
- Excludes AFK players from vote calculations
- Works on multiworld servers with per-world rules

## Premium Features

- One main control menu for voting and admin actions
- Configurable GUI with slots, materials, names, lore, and decorative items
- MiniMessage and HEX color support
- Live BossBar and ActionBar vote status
- Dynamic vote percentages based on online player count
- Optional rewards for participation and successful votes
- YAML or SQLite statistics storage
- Leaderboards and player stats
- PlaceholderAPI integration
- Optional Vault economy support
- Soft-hook support for AFK plugins, Geyser, and Floodgate setups

## Included Menus

- Main menu for players and admins
- Vote YES / Vote NO buttons
- Current vote status panel
- Stats and leaderboards shortcuts
- Reload, stop, and version actions for staff

## Placeholders

```text
%smartsleep_nights_skipped%
%smartsleep_rain_skipped%
%smartsleep_vote_yes%
%smartsleep_vote_no%
%smartsleep_vote_timer%
%smartsleep_player_votes%
%smartsleep_top_voter%
```

## Commands

```text
/smartsleep
/smartsleep reload
/smartsleep start [night|rain]
/smartsleep stop
/smartsleep stats
/smartsleep top
/smartsleep version
```

## Permissions

```text
smartsleep.vote
smartsleep.admin
smartsleep.start
smartsleep.stats
smartsleep.top
```

All permission nodes can be renamed in `config.yml`.

## Storage

Choose one backend:

- `YAML` for simple setups
- `SQLITE` for busy survival servers

Storage is saved asynchronously to reduce TPS impact.

## Recommended Settings

For larger networks, enable these:

```yaml
settings:
  storage: SQLITE
  force-modern-visuals: true

afk:
  enabled: true
  exclude-from-calculations: true
```

`force-modern-visuals` keeps the bundled premium menu/chat style in sync when you update from an older build.

## Why SmartSleep

Most sleep plugins stop at a basic percentage check. SmartSleep is built to feel like a real premium resource: clear UI, live feedback, configurable logic, and enough hooks to fit into a serious survival server.
